name: Juno
tagline: A stony-iron relic on one of the belt's most eccentric tracks.

facts.label: Eccentricity
facts.value: 0.256 — unusually stretched for a main-belt body

history: Juno was the third asteroid discovered and one of the largest S-type bodies — stony-iron composition dominated by olivine, the same material meteorites deliver to Earth. Its orbit is remarkably eccentric for the main belt, carrying it from inside the inner belt's edge out past the middle of the band each cycle. Infrared surveys show a lumpy, impact-battered silhouette: a survivor of collisions that scattered fragments across the inner Solar System.
